Spice Corp | founded = {{start date and age|1980}} | defunct = {{start date and age|2018}} | founder = [[Bhupendra Kumar Modi]] | hq_location_city = [[Singapore]] | hq_location_country = [[India]] | area_served = Worldwide | num_locations = | key_people = [[Ozi Amanat]] (CIO){{cite news|url=http://www.medianama.com/2013/01/223-spice-global-appoints-ozi-amanat-as-its-chief-investment-officer/|title=Spice Global Appoints Ozi Amanat As Its Chief Investment Officer|author=Vikas SN|date=Jan 3, 2013|publisher=Medianama.com|accessdate=8 January 2013}} | industry = [[Conglomerate (company)|Conglomerate]] | services = | products = | assets = {{Increase}} US$ 2 billion (2011){{cite news|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/todays-paper/tp-marketing/spice-retail-acquires-global-access/article976042.ece|title=Spice Retail acquires Global Access|date=January 22, 2010|work=[[The Hindu]]|accessdate=8 January 2013}} | num_employees = 10,000 | website = [http://www.spiceglobal.com/ Spice Global] }} '''DigiSpice''' (aka '''Spice Global''') was an Indian [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]] headquartered in [[Singapore]]. The company operates in the sectors of telecom, finance, entertainment and technology. They operate internationally in Los Angeles, New York, Kuala Lumpur, London, Dubai, Nepal, Bangladesh, Uganda, Tanzania, Zimbabwe, Sri Lanka and Shenzhen. In 2014, the company's aggregated assets totalled [[US$]]2 billion with over 10,000 employees worldwide. Spice Global is planning to offer full-fledged banking service, with focus on smart banking, which is showing a 227% annual growth, to its customers. It has applied to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for a license. The company is already offering financial services through Wall Street Finance, which has 6,000 sub-agents across India, including Vijaya Bank, ICICI Bank and Kotak.{{cite news|title=Spice Global plans to approach RBI for bank licence|url=http://profit.ndtv.com/news/corporates/article-spice-global-plans-to-approach-rbi-for-bank-licence-319511|accessdate=23 August 2013|newspaper=[[NDTV]]|date=14 March 2013|agency=PTI}} In 2014, the company made an aggressive bid to acquire the American business magazine [[Forbes]] Media, from the Forbes family and the private equity group [[Elevation Partners]]. [[Ozi Amanat]] valued the company and acquisition at $300–$500m and quoted it as one of the world’s most brilliant brands.{{cite news|title=Spice Global's BK Modi among top bidders for Forbes|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/media/spice-globals-bk-modi-among-top-bidders-for-forbes/articleshow/28854238.cms|newspaper=[[The Economic Times]] |date=16 January 2014|agency=ET Bureau}} The bid for Forbes was short listed as the 3 top bidders for acquisition, beating [[Time Inc]], [[21st Century Fox|Fox]], [[Bloomberg L.P.|Bloomberg]], [[Warren Buffett]] and other major investors. ==History== Spice Global was established in 1980 by [[B. K. Modi]] under the name, Modi Corp. Later, the company came to be known as MCorp Global and Spice Corp, before it finally became Spice Global. KURMANATH|date=June 15, 2012|work=[[The Hindu]]|accessdate=8 January 2013|location=HYDERABAD}} However, plans in 2012 revealed Spice Global would be listed in London.{{cite news|url=https://www.forbes.com/lists/2011/77/india-billionaires-11_Bhupendra-Kumar-Modi_FDK3.html|title=#52 Bhupendra Kumar Modi|year=2011|work=[[Forbes]]|accessdate=8 January 2013}}{{cite news|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2012-01-13/spice-global-s-modi-on-developing-markets-planned-ipo-video-.html|title=Spice Global's Modi on Developing Markets, Planned IPO (Video)|date=Jan 13, 2012|publisher=[[Bloomberg Businessweek]]|accessdate=8 January 2013}} Modi expects to raise [[US$]] 1 billion in the listing where London has agreed to the listing.{{cite news|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/industry-and-economy/info-tech/spice-group-plans-1b-london-listing/article2051747.ece|title=Spice Group plans $1-b London listing|date=May 26, 2012|work=[[The Hindu]]|accessdate=8 January 2013|location=London}} In May 2023, the Times of India reported that Spice Money, a subsidiary of Spice Global, was partnering with Boston Consulting Group (BCG) to strengthen its reach across India.{{Cite news |date=2023-05-11 |title=Fintech platform Spice Money partners BCG to improve its rural reach |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/fintech-platform-spice-money-partners-bcg-to-improve-its-rural-reach/articleshow/100154891.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-01-12 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} Spice Money was founded in 2015 and aims to develop financial strategies for rural customers in India in saving, credit, and commerce. The partnership with BCG will seek to identify financial areas that demand greater attention and support in rural communities. ==Proposed Operations== Spice Global Group plans to expand its footprint in Malaysia. Spice Global has a presence in Malaysia in the field of mobile software and hardware technology through Spice CSL. Spice Global had earlier taken over the Malaysian mobile company, CSL.{{Cite web |url=http://www.s-csl.my/ |title=Welcome to Spice CSL Group | Commitment Service Loyalty - Spice CSL |access-date=2013-01-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130105231233/http://www.s-csl.my/ |archive-date=2013-01-05 |url-status=dead }} The company did a business worth over US$100 million in Malaysia in 2012 and hopes to breach US$200 million (RM618 million) by 2014. This year, Spice CSL will launch two new smartphones and one tablet in Malaysia. The company is currently in talks with Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) and Bank Islam Malaysia Bhd for strategic partnerships for its proposed banking business. Spice Global is interested in entering the Malaysian healthcare sector and is in talks with IHH Healthcare Bhd for a partnership. The company also plans to buy a property in Putrajaya. == Awards and honors == * 2007 Golden Peacock certificates for innovative products/services * Global premier of the World's First Movie Phone{{cite web |url=http://news.indiamart.com/story/s-mobility-ltd-handover-handset-business-s-mobile-device-limited-163929.html |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130216063853/http://news.indiamart.com/story/s-mobility-ltd-handover-handset-business-s-mobile-device-limited-163929.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=2013-02-16 |title=S Mobility to handover Handset business to S Mobile Device |publisher=News.indiamart.com |date=2012-07-06 |accessdate=2013-01-08 }} * 2008 Peoples' phone at the World Mobile Congress, Barcelona * Product of the Year Innovation Award 2010 * Spice Mobility ranked 10 in Asia's 200 Best Under A Billion{{cite news|url=https://www.forbes.com/lists/2010/24/asia-under-billion-10_Spice-Mobility_8L2X.html|title=Asia's 200 Best Under A Billion|date=September 1, 2010|work=[[Forbes]]|accessdate=8 January 2013 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110613095140/https://www.forbes.com/lists/2010/24/asia-under-billion-10_Spice-Mobility_8L2X.html |archive-date=2011-06-13}} ==Subsidiaries== * Si2i Mobility ** Si2i - Representing mobility businesses outside India.
